title: India: CJP's Dipke detained amid call for fresh Delhi demo
summary: Police placed the founder of the Cockroach Janta Party, Abhijeet Dipke, in preventive detention. He was calling for a protest in central Delhi in defiance of a court order banning it. DW has more.

image.caption: Thousands of youth protesters, including CJP and student leaders, were detained last weekend after police denied them permission to protestImage: Priyanshu Singh/REUTERS

blocks.text: Foreign minister to hold talks with US's Rubio next week
Foreign Minster S. Jaishankar will meet with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio for talks next week, a ministry spokesperson told reporters on Friday.
The pair will meet in India's financial capital Mumbai on Tuesday, Randhir Jaiswal said during a briefing.
He said the talks were expected to cover key areas of bilateral cooperation, including energy, trade and investment, defense, and critical and emerging technologies.

The announcement comes a day after Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said that the "first tranche" of a trade deal first touted by Narendra Modi and Donald Trump in 2025 had been "finalized," and was going through the "final contours" and "legal drafting."
US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor was slightly less explicit but he also said that negotiations were moving at an "incredible pace" and that the "big items" were "done."
The talks have at times been overshadowed by Trump's notoriously erratic tariff policies, which have often affected India.
Rubio also visited India in May this year.
